catalog_quote: Word stress falls on the penultimate syllable of the root. With the addition of suffixes stress shifts to the resulting penultimate syllable. However, with the addition of enclitics stress does not shift to the right. Each vowel counts as the nucleus of a separate syllable. audit.reasoning: Coding fixed-strict penultimate (penultimate stress), in the dominant set, is correct: Martens 1988:157 'In a word base, stress is always penultimate', with the domain = word base (root + derivational suffixes; enclitic pronouns/aspect markers outside, pp.159-160), each vowel a syllable (p.157), and Esser 1964:5-6 independently states the same rule and the same suffix/enclitic split. Two caveats worth carrying into the note, neither a reclassify: (i) rising vowel sequences act as one unit so stress is phonetically antepenultimate in forms like páea/dáeo' (Martens sec.3.1.5; Esser p.5 'verhuist de klemtoon naar de derde van achteren'); (ii) Esser reports -aka taking stress on its own first syllable. The weakness is purely evidential: the record still rests on the StressTyp2 paraphrase of a 1995 wordlist introduction and explicitly says Martens 1988 was 'not re-opened', although the primary phonology is now o
audit.second_reader_evidence: Quote finding confirmed: the record's quote/cite/loc are empty and the deciding text is the StressTyp2 paraphrase (the domain quotation, passage 1964, Martens 1995 CAD), with the record itself stating 'Martens 1988/1995 not re-opened'. Re-opened the held primary phonology, Martens 1988 'Phonology of Uma' PL A-79, text layer; PDF p.5 = printed p.157, header verified): p.157 sec.2.1 'phonetically long vowels are interpreted as sequences of two or more syllables of the same vowel.. Vowel glides are here interpreted as sequences of two or more syllables.. This interpretation is consistent with the rule of penultimate stress on the word base'

sources.quote: 'De klemtoon valt op de voorlaatste lettergreep van het stamwoord. Bestaat deze uit een enkele klinker die zich leent tot het vormen van een tweeklank met een voorafgaande klinker, dan verhuist de klemtoon naar de derde van achteren, bv. páea "rijst hebbende", páiwa' "varkenstrog". Deze regel geldt dus ook bij aanhechting van het achtervoegsel -a, dat anders, evenals het achtervoegsel -i, de klemtoon doet verspringen naar de voorafgaande lettergreep ... Bij aanhechting van -aka valt hij op de eerste lettergreep van dit achtervoegsel ... Bij aanhechting van het suffix -ka (-ki, -ko) en bij aanh
